header: Duration, host and agenda of a demo
lead: An invitation to a live demo, with the agenda as icon points between two lines.
note: The band links to a booking page and never embeds a calendar. An external booking script would load on every page that uses this element.

agenda.title: Up to six points
agenda.text: Each has an icon, a title and one sentence. With no points, the lines disappear too.

agenda.title: Two to four columns
agenda.text: The agenda adapts to the space it has, not to the screen width.

agenda.title: Media on either side
agenda.text: The reverse switch swaps the halves. Without an image, the text fills the whole band.

agenda.title: One button, one link
agenda.text: The button opens the calendar. The link is for readers who aren't ready to pick a time yet.

image.alternative: A woman in waders takes a water sample from a shallow river.
